text: On the FindThePlus task, where the verifier sees only part of a 10x10 image and relies on the prover to say where to look, the paper reports that the PVG-trained frozen verifier achieves perfect precision against an optimized prover and 0.99 precision against directly optimized proof vectors, while the collaboratively trained verifier achieves exactly 0 precision.
title: PVG FindThePlus: frozen verifier keeps precision 1.0 (prover) and 0.99 (messages)
